description: 《Hung Up》描寫一個人在愛情中苦苦等待，從深深迷戀逐漸走向失望與決心放手的心情。歌中的主角日夜盼望心愛的人來電，對方的一言一行都牽動著她的情緒，令等待的每一分鐘都顯得格外漫長。然而，對方始終猶豫不決，遲遲沒有給予明確的回應，使她逐漸感到疲憊與不滿。她終於意識到自己不能無止境地等待，決定停止執著，重新掌握生活的方向。歌曲中的電話與時鐘象徵情感上的依戀，以及時間流逝帶來的焦慮。最終，《Hung Up》傳達的是愛情中的渴望、失望與自我覺醒：即使曾經深深迷戀一個人，也應懂得珍惜自己的時間與尊嚴，勇敢放下沒有回應的等待，重新尋找屬於自己的幸福。

vocabulary.usage: 想說幾分鐘、幾小時或幾年慢慢過去時，可以用 time goes by 或 the days go by。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「go by」表示時間流逝？
options: I go by my tea at seven, and then I eat the cup.
Three hours went by, but the train still did not come.
Monday went by the window and asked for a ticket.
The calendar went by taxi because Friday was too far away.
optionExplanations: go by 在本題不是「喝茶」的動詞；可說 I drink tea at seven.
三小時過去了，火車仍未到站；went by 正確描述時間流逝。
星期一不是會經過窗戶、購買車票的旅客；可說 Monday came, and I went to work.
日曆不會因為星期五太遠就搭計程車；可說 I looked at the calendar and waited for Friday.
vocabulary.explanation: 三小時過去了，火車仍未到站；went by 正確描述時間流逝。

vocabulary.meaning: 對某人十分著迷、念念不忘。
vocabulary.usage: 一直想著某個人，難以放下時，可以說 be hung up on someone。注意：這和 hang up on someone（掛斷某人的電話）意思不同。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「hung up on」表示對某人念念不忘？
options: The dentist is hung up on my tooth because it called him at midnight.
My jacket is hung up on the singer, and now it wants an autograph.
Nora is still hung up on her old boyfriend and talks about him every day.
The museum was hung up on the wall, so it closed at five.
optionExplanations: 牙齒不會半夜打電話給牙醫；可說 The dentist checked my tooth.
外套不會迷戀歌手並索取簽名；可說 My jacket is hanging on a hook.
Nora 每天談起前男友，表示她仍難以放下這段感情；用法正確。
這裡把整座博物館當成能掛上牆的物品，沒有表達對人的留戀；可說 The museum closes at five.
vocabulary.explanation: Nora 每天談起前男友，表示她仍難以放下這段感情；用法正確。

vocabulary.usage: 想強調某件事白天和晚上都持續進行時，可以用 night and day。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「night and day」表示日夜持續？
options: Night and day are two new students, and both forgot their names.
The office hired Night and Day, but neither one knew how to type.
I put night and day in two boxes so they would not fight.
The hospital is open night and day, so people can get help at any time.
optionExplanations: 本題要表達時間持續，不是替兩名學生取名為 Night 和 Day；可說 Two new students forgot their names.
把黑夜與白天當成兩位受雇員工，並不是表示持續營業；可說 The office is open every weekday.
白天和夜晚不是可以分裝進盒子的物品；可說 I work during the day and rest at night.
醫院日夜開放，符合 night and day 的用法。
vocabulary.explanation: 醫院日夜開放，符合 night and day 的用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 對某事感到厭煩、受夠了。
vocabulary.usage: 某件事一直發生，讓人不想再忍受時，可以說 be fed up with + 名詞／V-ing。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「fed up with」表示受夠了某件事？
options: She fed up the letter and sent it to the post office for dinner.
I'm fed up with this noise. I need a quiet place to study.
My alarm clock is fed up with seven o'clock and has asked for a new job.
The baker fed up with a ladder because the bread was on the roof.
optionExplanations: fed up with 不是把信餵飽或寄去吃飯；可說 She sent the letter at the post office.
噪音令人厭煩，所以想找安靜的地方讀書；用法自然。
鬧鐘不會向七點提出離職申請；可說 My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
把 fed up 當成「向上餵食」，和感到厭煩無關；可說 The baker used a ladder to get the bread.
vocabulary.explanation: 噪音令人厭煩，所以想找安靜的地方讀書；用法自然。

vocabulary.usage: 不確定要不要做某件事，因而遲遲無法決定時，可以用 hesitate；常見搭配是 hesitate to + 動詞。
options: Ben hesitated before opening the door because he heard a strange sound.
The traffic light hesitated its homework until all the cars were asleep.
Please hesitate the orange into four pieces and give me one.
The elevator hesitated about becoming a doctor, so it stayed on the third floor.
optionExplanations: Ben 聽到奇怪聲音，開門前有所遲疑，符合 hesitate 的意思。
紅綠燈不會拖延功課，車子也不是它的同學；可說 The traffic light turned red, and the cars stopped.
hesitate 不是切水果的動作；可說 Please cut the orange into four pieces.
電梯不會考慮轉職當醫生；可說 The elevator stopped on the third floor.
vocabulary.explanation: Ben 聽到奇怪聲音，開門前有所遲疑，符合 hesitate 的意思。

vocabulary.meaning: 陷入某件事、被某種情況纏住。
vocabulary.usage: 因為一個問題、活動或情緒而難以抽身時，可以說 be caught up in + 事情。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「caught up in」表示陷入某種情況？
options: I was caught up in a long meeting and missed your call.
The news caught up in my soup and asked for a spoon.
Our city was caught up in a small pocket, so the map asked for help.
The captain caught up in Wednesday and sailed to next Monday.
optionExplanations: 被一場冗長會議耽擱，因此錯過來電，正確表達難以抽身的情況。
新聞不會跳入湯裡並要求湯匙；可說 I heard the news while I was eating.
整座城市不能被困進小口袋；可說 Our city is on the map.
不能把星期三當成能把船長困住、再航行到星期一的海域；可說 The captain sailed across the sea on Wednesday.
vocabulary.explanation: 被一場冗長會議耽擱，因此錯過來電，正確表達難以抽身的情況。

vocabulary.usage: 到某個住處找人，卻沒有人在家時，可以說 there is no one home。歌詞也利用這句營造「無人回應」的感覺。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「no one home」表示家裡沒有人？
options: The hotel gave no one home a room because Nobody was its best guest.
I bought no one home at the supermarket, but the bag was empty.
The house said no one home because it wanted to live alone.
I rang the bell twice, but there was no one home.
optionExplanations: 把 no one 當成名叫 Nobody 的旅客，並非本題意思；可說 The hotel gave a guest a room.
no one 不是超市裡可購買的商品；可說 I went to the supermarket, but I bought nothing.
房子不會因為想獨居就開口拒絕訪客；可說 No one lives in that house now.
按了兩次門鈴仍沒人應門，正確表達家裡沒有人。
vocabulary.explanation: 按了兩次門鈴仍沒人應門，正確表達家裡沒有人。

vocabulary.meaning: 一點四十五分；距離兩點還有十五分鐘。
vocabulary.usage: 在口語中表示距離下一個整點還有十五分鐘，可以用 a quarter to + 小時。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「a quarter to two」表示時間？
options: We need a quarter to two chairs because the third chair is late.
The chef cut a quarter to two and served it with rice.
It's a quarter to two. The meeting starts in fifteen minutes.
The shop sold a quarter to two people, and both asked for change.
optionExplanations: 不能用 a quarter to two 表示需要四分之一張椅子；可說 We need two chairs.
a quarter to two 不是一道能切片上桌的食物；可說 The chef cut the cake into four pieces.
一點四十五分再過十五分鐘就是兩點，時間正確。
把 quarter 當作硬幣，並把 to two 當成賣給兩個人；本題是報時用語。可說 The shop sold two people some drinks.
vocabulary.explanation: 一點四十五分再過十五分鐘就是兩點，時間正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 掛斷某人的電話，常指對方還在通話時就掛斷。
vocabulary.usage: 想說某人突然結束與另一個人的通話時，可以用 hang up on + 人；過去式是 hung up on。這與第 2 題「對某人念念不忘」是不同用法。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「hang up on」表示掛斷某人的電話？
options: I hung up on my ticket, so the train could not read it.
The caller was rude, so Mia hung up on him.
The judge hung up on Tuesday because Monday had lost the case.
The phone hung up on the mountain and asked for a better view.
optionExplanations: 把車票「掛斷」不會讓火車看不懂票；可說 I lost my ticket, so I could not take the train.
因為來電者態度無禮，Mia 掛斷了他的電話；符合 hang up on someone 的意思。
法官不會把星期二當成通話對象，也沒有星期一打官司的情境；可說 The judge made a decision on Tuesday.
這裡把 hang up 誤用為掛在山上看風景，不是在掛電話；可說 The phone has no signal in the mountains.
vocabulary.explanation: 因為來電者態度無禮，Mia 掛斷了他的電話；符合 hang up on someone 的意思。

vocabulary.meaning: 找到自己的路；也可以比喻找到前進的方法或方向。
vocabulary.usage: 不知道接下來該怎麼辦，但相信自己能找到解決方法時，可以說 find my way。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「find my way」表示找到自己的方向或辦法？
options: I don't know what to do yet, but I will find my way.
The road found my way first, so I had to ask it for my name.
The bank found my way in a box and charged me five dollars to see it.
My camera found my way and put it in the lost-and-found room.
optionExplanations: 雖然還不知道該怎麼做，但相信自己能找到方向或辦法；符合歌詞語意。
道路不會搶先找到你的方向，再要求你報上姓名；可說 I asked someone for directions.
把人生方向當成銀行收在盒子裡、需要付費觀看的物品；可說 The bank charged me five dollars.
find my way 不是遺失物招領室裡的一件物品；可說 My camera is in the lost-and-found room.
vocabulary.explanation: 雖然還不知道該怎麼做，但相信自己能找到方向或辦法；符合歌詞語意。
